# Blue Summit Supplies

> > Blue Summit Supplies is a Huntsville-based office and school supply retailer offering factory-direct bulk ordering with free nationwide shipping and specialized business forms.

Founded by Owen Franklin, Blue Summit Supplies specializes in bulk office supplies, tax forms, and business products with direct wholesale pricing. The company serves businesses, schools, and organizations with a focus on bulk packs, custom quotes, and hard-to-find items like tax forms compatible with QuickBooks and IRS requirements.

## Key Topics

- Bulk office supplies
- Tax forms (1099, W2, 1096)
- Envelopes and mailing supplies
- QuickBooks compatible products
- School supplies
- Business forms
- Wholesale pricing
- Free nationwide shipping
- Custom bulk quotes
- IRS compliance
- Desk organization
- Shipping supplies
- Binders and folders
- E-filing support
- Owen Franklin (Founder)

## Core Products & Catalogs

- [Envelopes](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/envelopes): Business envelope catalog with window, security-tint, and QuickBooks-compatible options
- [Binders](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/binders): Product catalog of 3-ring and D-ring binders in bulk packs
- [Folders](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/folders): Folder collection featuring classification, file, and fastener folders in bulk
- [Paper and Pads](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/paper-and-pads): Paper products including security checks, thermal paper, bond paper, and memo pads
- [Binder Accessories](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/binder-accessories): Binder accessories including dividers, sheet protectors, and index dividers

## Business & Tax Forms

- [Forms](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/forms): Business and tax forms including CMS-1500, W2, 1099-NEC, and 1099 MISC
- [Bulk Envelopes](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/pages/bulk-envelopes): Factory-direct wholesale bulk envelope ordering with custom quotes and pallet quantities

## Office & Organization Supplies

- [Shipping Supplies](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/shipping-supplies): Shipping supplies including mailers, expansion envelopes, and conformer envelopes
- [Desk Organization](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/desk-organization): Desk organization products with filing systems and storage solutions
- [Office Tools](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/office-tools): Office tools collection with clipboards, scissors, rulers, and organizational supplies
- [Fasteners](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/fasteners): Fasteners collection with staplers, staples, and stapler sets
- [Adhesives](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/adhesives): Adhesives including packaging tape, painters tape, duct tape, and fiberglass tape

## School & Specialty Supplies

- [School Supplies](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/school-supplies): School supplies including dry erase boards, book covers, and pencil boxes
- [Planners and Journals](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/planners-and-journals): Planners and journals including executive, travel, and visitor log books
- [Writing and Correction](https://www.bluesummitsupplies.com/collections/writing-and-correction): Writing and correction supplies including erasers in bulk packs
